fix_history: Fix 1: Replaced invalid 8-char hash '861750ba' with correct 32-char MD5 '3d465870a880c6e96493a5637b57636e' (computed from 'ec71221e-ac43-46f9-89b8-ee7d80f7e1c5|2') in getter and metric function names

Fix 2: Changed evaluator.func from 'vscode_py_indent_docstring__861750ba' to 'check_vscode_py_indent_docstring__3d465870a880c6e96493a5637b57636e' to match the actual metric function name with check_ prefix
Fix 3: evaluator.result.type updated to 'vscode_py_indent_docstring__3d465870a880c6e96493a5637b57636e' (no get_ prefix, per evaluator.md rule)

Fix 4: Renamed variable 'found_def' -> 'in_func_body' in getter function; the old name ended with 'def' so the pattern 'found_def and (' was matched by the validator regex def\s+([a-zA-Z0-9_]+)\s*\( as a spurious getter function named 'and', causing the rule-validation error.

Fix 5: Expanded indent_ok to check ALL non-empty lines in lines[1:10] (lines 2-10, 1-indexed) for >= 4 leading spaces, replacing the previous spot-check of only 2 content-searched lines ('n = len(alist)' and 'for j in range...').

Fix 6: Added REQUIRED_DOCSTRING_TEXT check ('Sort the list in-place using bubble sort.') to has_docstring; previously any triple-quoted string would pass, making arbitrary docstrings (e.g. '"""Hello"""') a false positive.
